records.title: Report of Aircraft accident investigation Bureau.
details: a to b: The investigation is under progress. All probable causes leading to accident are being investigated. The final investigation report will be published after completion of the investigation.

records.title: GENERAL VERIFICATION OF TRADE UNIONS MEMBERSHIP
details: a to c: The process of general verification of trade unions membership which started in 2012-13, was put on hold in view of the formulation of new Labour Codes containing various provisions, including recognition of the Trade Union at Central and State level.

records.title: Assessment of Gig and Platform Workers
details: Part (d) and (e): The provisions of the Code are yet to come into effect.
